expected_grant_revision.description: Required CAS discriminator: explicit null means create only if the exact grant key is absent; an integer means compare that existing revision. Missing this member is invalid. Neither branch permits an unconditional write.

build_grant_revoke_request.description: Current versioned grant-targeted revoke; build_grant_revoke_request_legacy_v1 preserves the original historical shape without current dispatch authority.

permission_rule_command_request_v2.description: PS-144 command-specific admission: validate_rule writes nothing; mutations CAS the actual owning collection revision/hash, and update/reorder/delete/revoke name a stable rule_id. Creating/updating a durable allow needs the explicit person choice, including in YOLO. Repository origin/loosening acceptance is rechecked from the actual source by the owner; non-repository rules need no fabricated repository acceptance and ordinary revoke/delete do not manufacture a human-only gate.

build_grant_revoke_request_v2.description: PS-147 revoke targets the actual grant_id and expected revision under the current context actor/permission authority. It consumes no approval preview or replacement resource selection. Historical requests are retained separately for exact reading/replay only.
